flawed_step: 0169: The inversion conclusion is asserted without the necessary hypothesis α(1)≠0; the displayed coefficients subsequently divide by α(1), and F does not determine G when α(1)=0.
counterexample: Let α(n)=0 for every n and G(X)=1. Then F(X)=0 satisfies 0167, but G cannot be recovered from F and the proposed β is undefined because α(1)=0.
